data.name: Mahitha
data.gender_notes: Mahitha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mahith' which means 'great' or 'powerful'. In Hindu mythology, Mahitha is the name of a celestial being or goddess revered for her immense power and wisdom. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess strong and inspiring qualities. The name Mahitha carries the meaning “Greatness, Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahitha usually hope their child will grow to embody greatness, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine power and wisdom.
data.etymology: Mahitha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Greatness, Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahitha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
